assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Educational walking game, mobile thumbnail. Match reference visual style ONLY: very thick dark navy outlines, rounded joints, simple blue-shirt dark-trousers yellow-backpack faceless adult, pale blue background, gray pavement. Large person fills 60 percent of image height. Very few broad shapes, no tiny details, no text, numbers, arrows, checkmarks, approval colors, speech balloons, or injury. One 3:2 landscape image, readable at 94x64 pixels. Keep important features away from upper-left corner where UI number overlays. NEW SCENE, no utility pole or wire. A flooded street. Oblique side view: main road runs left to right, right half covered by opaque muted blue floodwater, completely concealing road surface, with only two broad ripples. A dry side road branches toward lower-left behind the person. Person stands center-left on dry pavement facing the water ahead. All main elements large; waterline clearly separated from feet by open dry pavement. No visible water bottom, drain, hidden obstacles, shelter, distant scenery or rain clutter. Do not depict a river: this is water pooled across a roadway with a road continuing behind it.

Edit this illustration into action option: person turns LEFT away from flooded road and WALKS BACK toward the dry branch lower-left. Same large blue-shirt yellow-backpack character, full body, clear walking stride facing away from water. Keep flooded waterline and road geometry exactly the same. Same very thick navy outlines and sparse large shapes, 3:2. No arrows, text, marks, additional people or new hazards. Readable at 94x64px. Only change person pose and a small movement along dry pavement.

Edit this scene into a hypothetical action option. Preserve road and opaque floodwater geometry, simple thick navy outlines and large character. Move same blue-shirt yellow-backpack person to the NEAR EDGE of water at center-right. Person leans forward looking at feet and cautiously extends one foot into the opaque water along its near edge, other foot still on dry road. Show the extended shoe partially obscured by water, but do not reveal water bottom or assign a depth. Full body large, clear bent-neck and tentative stepping pose. No stick, extra tools, text, icons, arrows, injury, successful crossing, or extra people. 3:2. Important: water remains opaque and forward path not proven safe.

Edit this scene into another action option: blue-shirt yellow-backpack person remains standing on DRY road before floodwater, and faces a passing adult in muted purple shirt and dark trousers to ask them about the route. Two large simple faceless people in conversation, one open hand gesture, both feet visibly dry, waterline behind/right with no body-water overlap. Preserve same road fork and floodwater geometry, crop closer if necessary so each person roughly 60 percent image height, very thick navy outline, simple style. No phone, speech bubbles, text, checkmarks, arrows or injury. Do not show the passerby successfully crossing water; they are already on dry side. 3:2.
